title: Photograph: Ghar-e-Hira

paras.en: The cave of Hira, where the first revelation was sent down.
paras.ur: غارِ حرا، جہاں پہلی وحی نازل ہوئی
paras.ps: د حرا غار، چېرته چې لومړنۍ وحې نازله شوه.

sourceNote: Printed page 27: a full-page photograph of a rocky hillside with people standing on it, captioned “غارِ حرا، جہاں پہلی وحی نازل ہوئی”. The photograph is not reproduced; only its caption is given. A faint handwritten mark under the page number is excluded. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1.
